plain: Made up of parts that are all the same kind.

webster.text: Of the same kind or nature; consisting of similar parts, or of elements of the like nature.

example.quote: We cannot however be regarded even at this time, as one homogeneous mass, in which every thing that affects a part will affect in the same manner the whole.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 26, 1787
